title: Cosmos DB change feed and event-driven processing

videos.script: Every write to a Cosmos DB container goes into its change feed. {{feed}} The feed is the container's items, in the order they last changed. A program reads it from the beginning, or from a token it saved last time. {{token}} By default the feed keeps only the latest version of each item. Three updates in a minute show up as one. A deleted item does not show up at all. {{latest}} So a delete is written as an update first. A flag says deleted, and a time to live removes the item later. {{soft}} You will build a small processor. It turns Quitanda's orders into what each customer has spent. It keeps its place in a blob. And you will crash it on purpose, between the work and the checkpoint. {{crash}} Then the other mode, all versions and deletes. It keeps every step and every delete, for a limited time. {{versions}} Last, the machinery Azure builds around the feed: the change feed processor, its leases, and the Functions trigger. No emulator runs those, so they are taught from Microsoft's documentation. {{functions}}
